failure_mode_prevented: Asking the user what the repo already answers
rule: Read code/configs/docs/schemas first; discoverable unknowns are never questions

failure_mode_prevented: Question overload; user fatigue before design is done
rule: Sort unknowns: discoverable→look up; defaultable→assumption ledger with default; user-owned→ask
Max 2 rounds and ~7 questions for a typical feature; excess questions are usually defaultable

failure_mode_prevented: User has to design the answer themselves
rule: Every question carries why-it-matters + a recommended answer; a good round can be approved with 'yes to all'

failure_mode_prevented: Silent assumptions discovered as bugs later
rule: Present defaults as a ledger for one objection pass instead of asking more questions

failure_mode_prevented: Decisions living only in chat scrollback
rule: Phase 1 ends with a written Decision Record; Phase 2 consumes only that artifact

failure_mode_prevented: Plan unusable by anyone who wasn't in the chat
rule: A competent agent with no conversation access could implement from the plan alone
Every boundary written exactly: signatures API shapes DDLs config keys metric names CLI commands
Plan lists every path with create/modify and what changes

failure_mode_prevented: Edge cases discovered by workers mid-run
rule: Walk the sweep list (empty input idempotency concurrency time scale migration observability secrets failure rollback); N/A allowed silence not
Plan states exact commands smoke path and expected outputs per change type

failure_mode_prevented: Workers editing the plan to match what they did
rule: Plan immutable during execution; deviations reported in MRs; human amends between waves
Issue written for a worker who never saw plan or conversation; all needed info in the body
Contracts decisions edge-case behaviors and examples pasted verbatim into the issue
Exact names and signatures copied from the plan; paraphrase is where drift starts
Slice at frozen interface boundaries; each issue implements one side of a contract

failure_mode_prevented: Parallel workers colliding in the same file
rule: File-ownership table per wave; overlap → merge slices sequence them or extract a foundation issue
Smallest number of issues under the size cap; never split mid-behavior (code + tests + wiring together)
One foundation issue for schemas/base classes/plumbing; everything else blocked_by it

failure_mode_prevented: Plan details missing from every issue
rule: Every plan item maps to exactly one issue with verbatim text; any gap fixed before dispatch
Every AFK issue lists files and behaviors it must leave alone
Exact verification commands with expected output in every issue
Verify blocked_by issues actually merged/closed immediately before each claim

failure_mode_prevented: Dependent branch created from master dropping blocker work
rule: Branch from the blocker's branch; MR targets it; retarget after merge
